description:
The Property
Situated in the heart of Woolwich, SE18, this beautifully presented two-bedroom apartment offers contemporary living in one of South East London's most well-connected and rapidly evolving locations. Finished to an exceptional standard throughout, this stylish home is perfect for first-time buyers, professionals, downsizers or investors looking for a property that combines modern living with outstanding convenience.

Stepping inside, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hall leading to a stunning open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, creating the perfect space for both relaxing and entertaining. The contemporary kitchen offers an excellent range of fitted units and integrated appliances, while the generous living space is flooded with natural light thanks to large windows and direct access onto a private balcony—the ideal place to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a busy day.

The apartment offers two well-proportioned double bedrooms, with the impressive principal bedroom benefiting from its own stylish en-suite shower room. A beautifully appointed family bathroom serves the second bedroom and guests, both finished with modern fixtures and fittings.

Beautifully decorated throughout, the property is completely move-in ready, offering a bright, contemporary interior that has been thoughtfully designed to maximise both space and comfort.

Perfectly positioned for commuters, the property enjoys exceptional transport links. Woolwich Elizabeth Line Station provides fast services into Canary Wharf, Liverpool Street, Farringdon and Heathrow Airport, while Woolwich Arsenal Station offers National Rail and DLR connections into Central London. There are also excellent local bus routes and easy access to the Woolwich Ferry, making travel across London quick and convenient.

Property Description
Residents are also within easy walking distance of the Royal Arsenal Riverside development, home to a fantastic selection of cafés, restaurants, bars and independent shops. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the beautiful open spaces of Woolwich Common, Oxleas Woods, Shrewsbury Park and the scenic Thames Path are all close by, offering excellent walking, cycling and recreational opportunities.

Combining stylish interiors, generous living accommodation, outstanding transport connections and a sought-after London location, this superb apartment presents an exceptional opportunity to enjoy modern city living at its finest.

Property ownership information

Ground rent review period: Every 250 years

Service charge review period: Every 1 year

Lease end date: 20/07/3010

Property Description Disclaimer

This is a general description of the property only, and is not intended to constitute part of an offer or contract. It has been verified by the seller(s), unless marked as "draft". Purplebricks conducts some valuations online and some of our customers prepare their own property descriptions, so if you decide to proceed with a viewing or an offer, please note this information may have been provided solely by the vendor, and we may not have been able to visit the property to confirm it. If you require clarification on any point then please contact us, especially if you’re traveling some distance to view. All information should be checked by your solicitor prior to exchange of contracts.

Successful buyers will be required to complete anti-money laundering and proof of funds checks. The current non-refundable cost is £80 inc. VAT per offer. You’ll need to pay this to Purplebricks and complete all checks before we can issue a memorandum of sale. The cost includes obtaining relevant data and any manual checks and monitoring which might be required.

This striking, mid-level three-double-bedroom apartment (measuring 1,497 sq.ft.) with additional sky lounge 402 sq.ft. (ownership is excluded from lease, but demised to the apartment), therein totalling 1,899 sq.ft. of usable space.

The apartment is on the favoured north side of the building, enjoying uninterrupted views over the River Thames, dome of St Paul’s to the City of London cityscape beyond.

On arrival, residents access valet parking through 24-hour concierge. Three lifts supply 21st floor and the apartment proper.

A generous entrance hall welcomes guests, side cloakroom, double storage cupboard with hanging rails, and utility cupboard (containing washer/dryer, ironing facilities, plant for VRF heating/cooling system and underfloor heating). The apartment has underfloor heating throughout, comfort cooling/heating and dimmable Leutron style lighting.

Its interior design specification has been significantly upgraded by the present owners using ‘London Design Group’, who layered rich textures and elegant finishes with carefully chosen accents of colours across each room, thus adding depth, vibrancy, and comfort to the property. The result is a timeless stylish, homely interior that balances refinement with comfort.

The open-plan reception feels particularly spacious with impressive lateral scale 9.85m x 7.65m. Floor-to-ceiling windows (fitted with privacy sheers and curtains) allow natural light to flood the property, enhancing the elevated views.

The kitchen/dining/sitting room creates an ideal space for relaxed living and entertaining. A contemporary kitchen has Miele appliances (Dina cooling fridge and freezer, dishwasher, coffee machine, combination microwave and oven, warming draw, fan assisted oven & grill, sink/drainer with food disposal system). There are useful wall and base storage units with downlit fabricated stone work surfaces. Natural stone has been used throughout the apartment to elevate its finish, principally in kitchen, bathrooms and on flooring with large format tiles used, and hand fabricated vanity and sink units.

A large central island separates the kitchen from reception sitting room (fronted by four comfortable bar stools). Its orientation provides the perfect platform for food preparation, whilst allowing one to engage with the room's wider audience when entertaining. The island contains a four-zone Miele induction hob with rising extractor hood and temperature regulated wine fridge (with cooling and warming).

The sitting room area is fitted with a central media unit (with a Samsung smart TV & Sonos soundbar). The room comfortably accommodates large soft furnishings, coffee table, side tables and cabinetry; from comfortable seating one can adjourn to the sky lounge or formal dining area. These two principal entertaining spaces take in the best views day and night, especially the illuminated cityscape.

The dining area takes a dining table for eight persons, and has a beautiful contemporary blown glass chandelier to its centre. The sky lounge allows space for relaxed seating and coffee table and wraps around the entire frontage of the apartment. Multiple sets of louvre windows can be opened to take fresh air.

The three bedrooms are all on the east side receiving the morning light. The principal double bedroom fits a super-king, with side tables and show of fitted wardrobes (with concealed entertainment system to centre). The wardrobe doors and headboard are of high design specification with leather trims. The principal en-suite bathroom has walk in shower wet-room (with rainforest and hose heads), Villeroy & Boch bath tub, heated - towel rail, mirror, underfloor heating and stone sink vanity unit.

One of the guest double bedrooms has fitted wardrobes and both share a well presented adjoining bathroom. All bedrooms are finished to an exceptional standard of interior design. The bedrooms are carpeted soft pile, and enjoy views towards the River Thames. The third guest bedroom would make an ideal home office with views over the river.

This is a truly remarkable turn-key apartment, well located to the City of London financial centre and ideally suited for young professionals, international purchasers, investors or those looking for a water fronted London residence.

One Blackfriars has a dedicated residents lounge on 32 floor, enclosed executive meeting room, private cinema, wine tasting room and golf simulator (all of which can be booked by residents for private functions).

Its Spa facilities include, wellness facilities, 20 meter swimming pool, thermal suite, yoga garden and fully equipped gym. The apartment is also 0.3miles from Bernie Spain Gardens - open green space.

The building is adjacent to world class cultural attractions including, London’s famous Borough Market (offering international cuisines), Tate Modern, Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre, British Film Institute, OXO Tower, Southbank Centre as well as an array of excellent shops, restaurants, cafés, public houses, sports and leisure amenities.
